title: Concept: Requirement written with two version components
description: go.mod declares a requirement version with no patch component, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement version with no patch component.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement version with no patch component.
